status: Approved for release 0.215.0; source validation and publication tracked in release notes.
selection: CSS data-map-realm comes directly from StageMap.realm. All 11 campaign realms plus ruin and legacy rift are covered; unknown values retain the approved generic fallback.
export: Each original PNG is preserved in assets-src/maps. Scroll JPEG: 1536x1024, quality 90. Paper JPEG: plain 256x256 crop from x=600,y=340, quality 90, for repeat without stretching center grain. Artwork is not retouched.

maps.name: Aurelion
maps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production UI asset for original dark-fantasy game Shattered Rifts.
Input reference is the approved generic scroll; preserve its physical aged parchment, overhead flat composition, rolled top and bottom edges, ragged left/right edges, fine hand-inked cartography, restrained painterly finish and overall 1536x1024 landscape proportions.
Create a DISTINCT realm-themed sibling, not a recolour. Entire parchment sheet fills frame, no desk or props, no perspective. Warm pale antique paper with varied grain and creases. Realm-specific hand-drawn landmarks must be concentrated in the FOUR CORNERS and narrow upper/lower strips: critical details must fit within the outer 20% left/right and outer 25% top/bottom, because the game nine-slices these margins around a long map. Central 60% width and middle 50% height must stay very quiet, almost blank parchment for interactive nodes; faint contours only, no dominant central subject. Use faded realm ink washes without making center dark. A modest non-lettered compass ornament near lower right.
No labels, NO text, letters, numbers, lettering, symbols resembling writing, titles or watermark. No baked-in nodes, marker circles, dotted routes, roads, UI or characters. Match the reference's refined hand-drawn scroll style. Generate one single complete map, not a contact sheet.
Realm: Aurelion. Gilded ivory cathedral spires, sacred walled citadels, heraldic sun medallions and marble bridges on mountainous cliffs. Warm gold and faded royal-blue inks.
